_comment: Manufacturer capability tables for fluxplace fabcaps.py. Every table carries `source` (URL) and `retrieved` (date). All lengths mm. Add vendors/tiers HERE, not in code. A tier = one price level (rank: lower is cheaper); its rows select by copper layer count. `unverified` lists keys whose value is NOT stated on the vendor page (carried as a conservative assumption). `price_step` quotes the vendor's own wording for what pushes a feature to a costlier tier; the vendors publish no per-feature prices on these pages (instant-quote form only). mil->mm: 4 mil=0.1016 but PCBWay states 0.1 mm for the 4 mil class and JLCPCB 0.09 for 3.5 mil; the vendor's mm figure is used.

plating_um.source: IPC-6012 Class 2 average via-barrel copper (not published on the vendor capability pages)

impedance.price_step: published only as an instant-quote option; price not published

via_in_pad.price_step: "may be more expensive than traditional PTHs" (resin filled + electroplated cap); no dimension limits given

blind_buried.price_step: "can significantly increase the cost of the circuit board"; IPC advice: via dia not above 6 mil (150 um)

heavy_copper.price_step: Advanced table: 0.5-4 oz normal, 4-6 oz medium difficulty, >6 oz high difficulty

standard.description: PCBWay Standard PCB table (headline service); annular ring: Standard table says 0.15 mm (hard), Advanced table lists 0.254 mm for component holes (pth_annular_advisory, reported as a note)
standard.source: https://www.pcbway.com/capabilities.html (Standard PCB + Advanced PCB 'Normal process' columns)
standard.price_step: Standard table: holes "smaller than 0.2mm will be subject to extra charges"; layers above 14 need the Advanced table

fine-drill.description: PCBWay Standard table with 0.15-0.2 mm drills (extra-charge band)
fine-drill.price_step: Standard table: holes "smaller than 0.2mm will be subject to extra charges"; Advanced table: drill <0.2 mm aspect ratio >=10 is medium difficulty

impedance.tolerance: +/-10% standard (+/-5 ohm below 50 ohm); +/-5% on special request
impedance.price_step: "tight impedance control" listed among options that "may increase both cost and production time"; price not published

via_in_pad.price_step: epoxy/copper-filled and capped 0.15-0.55 mm; "default for 6-layer and above"; via-covering page: "Complex process, high cost" (page also says free for 6+ layers - conflict, unverified)

blind_buried.price_step: "blind/buried vias, HDI (laser vias), heavy copper (up to 3oz)" "may increase both cost and production time"

heavy_copper.price_step: multilayer outer copper offered 1 / 2 oz only

standard.description: JLCPCB standard multilayer: 3.5/3.5 mil, 0.2 mm drill with >=0.45 mm via pad
standard.price_step: "0.1mm or 0.15mm hole size with any size via diameter, and 0.2mm or 0.25mm hole size with via diameter less than 0.45mm, will cost more."

unverified: odd layer counts not listed on the page
min thickness for 6+ layers not stated

fine-drill.description: JLCPCB multilayer with 0.15 mm drill / 0.25 mm via
fine-drill.price_step: "0.1mm or 0.15mm hole size with any size via diameter ... will cost more."

extreme-trace.description: JLCPCB 2.7/2.7 mil extreme line width/spacing plus 0.15 mm drills
extreme-trace.price_step: "In tight spaces, we support an extreme line width/spacing of 2.7/2.7 mil, but this will increase difficulty and cost."
unverified: extreme track/space is from the HDI FAQ and not confirmed for plain multilayer
